run_speech_recognition_from_vrs: run automated speech recognition on a VRS file using faster-whisper to transcribe audio into text segments
extract_audio_from_vrs: extract audio from a VRS file as a WAV file using the extract_audio function
transcribe_audio_with_word_timestamps: transcribe audio with per-word timestamps using faster-whisper and the WhisperModel transcribe API
align_timestamps_to_aria_domain: align speech recognition timestamps to the Aria VRS time domain using the data provider
export_transcription_to_csv: export transcribed word segments with timestamps and confidence scores to a CSV file
